purpose: Discovery/validation screen of 6 EGX-structure ideas. Fixed textbook thresholds, not tuned. Discovery 2017-01..2021-12 ; validation 2022-01..2024-12 (not looked at for these ideas) ; 2025-01..2026-11 exposed, informational only.
universe: ADV20 >= 5,000,000 EGP at t, close at t, no >11.5% close-to-close move in the 252 sessions up to t-1 (ex-ante hygiene). Entry = close of t+1; exit = close of t+1+H. Forward returns with |r|>60% are dropped symmetrically from events AND benchmark (split artefacts), count reported. Round-trip cost 0.96% (fee+slippage, impact ignored => optimistic).
benchmark: equal-weight mean forward return (same horizon) of ALL eligible names on the same signal date.

ideas.I1_limit_up_continuation: ret_t in [+9%,+11.5%] and volume_t >= 2 x mean volume(t-20..t-1); H=5
ideas.I2_limit_down_rebound: ret_t in [-11.5%,-9%] and volume_t >= 2 x mean volume(t-20..t-1); H=5
ideas.I3_volume_breakout: close_t > max close(t-20..t-1), volume_t >= 3 x mean volume(t-20..t-1), ret_t>0; H=10
ideas.I4_turn_of_month: equal-weight eligible universe, hold from close of the 2nd-last session of the month to close of the 3rd session of the next month (one round trip per month, cost 0.96%)
ideas.I6_oversold_in_uptrend: RSI(5, simple means of gains/losses) < 15 and close_t > MA200; H=5
ideas.I7_liquidity_surge: ADV20_t / mean(ADV20 over t-60..t-21) >= 2 and close_t > MA50; H=10

events: de-clustered: per ticker no new event within H sessions of the previous event
statistics: mean net excess over benchmark per event (I4: mean net monthly return); month-cluster bootstrap one-sided lower bound at alpha=0.05/6, 20000 draws, seed 20261106
pass_rule: an idea is a CANDIDATE only if: discovery mean net excess > 0 AND validation mean net excess > 0 AND validation lower bound (alpha 0.05/6) > 0 AND n_validation >= 100 (I4: >= 30 months). Candidates still only license forward paper testing; nothing licenses an executable recommendation.
weekday_note: mean eligible-universe daily return per weekday is reported descriptively (not an idea, not tested).
